evidence.summary: Unchanged in round 2: the per-request router log line still records product_lines=<all|assigned:n|unset>. The after_begin listener does not log (it would be one line per transaction). The read-only probe N0065_impl_r2_probe.py prints the bound setting and counts per scope for diagnosis. Live restart observed via cip-supervisor-status.ps1 (restarting -> healthy, /health 200).

rationale: Adequate for R2: an operator can see which branch each request bound, and the probe reproduces the per-transaction binding. Limitation: no metric or alert on scope decisions or on the '*' worker rebind.
